dedupe_keys.name: central chilean power grid topology and hourly activity

description: The Central Chilean power-grid collection provides network structure and hourly activity in three versions: with taps, without taps and a reduced network. The research team publishes node coordinates, labels, ownership and roles, together with edge endpoints, lengths and reported capacity information. Activity tables give hourly energy in MWh, both in their original form and with Kirchhoff adjustments that bring total nodal activity close to zero. Figshare hosts twelve CSV deposits, all under CC0 with free access. Spatial coverage is the Central Chilean grid. The inspected own metadata confirms hourly intervals but does not state the complete acquisition calendar, so the descriptor's dates have not been promoted to independently verified repository metadata. The collection can support power-flow and cascading-failure simulations, offering a national-system counterpart to data-re-europe. A caveat is that the three topology representations and adjusted versus original activity series serve different assumptions and should not be mixed silently. Additional impedance and dynamic parameters may be needed for a particular electrical simulator.
